resources.string: The encrypted vault now persists data. Do not enter real financial data yet.
A clear picture of your accounts
If this name already exists, its entry will be selected.
Tap an account to view its transactions.
Enter a positive amount with no more than two decimal places and a description.
Tap the checkbox to simulate clearing. The amount and ledger balance do not change.
SQLCipher vault and Android authentication. Test encrypted backup recovery on another phone before real use.
No network permission. No reports sent. Android blocks screenshots of application screens.
Validate the vault on physical devices, then complete account management and entry flows.
Language and formats follow phone settings. French and English are available.
Content is hidden after going into the background. This is a pause screen, without security authentication.
Restore completed. The accounts now match the backup. If a vault already existed, its previous state was backed up before replacement.
Backup selected. Enter its password to restore it.
Folder selected. Unlock the vault to continue backup settings.
Backup folder saved. You can continue configuration in settings.
Backups configured. You can now create a local encrypted backup.
%1$s (%2$s) will be deleted. Balances will be recalculated. This action is permanent.
What is new and what to test

Series-only settings (frequency, end date, remaining count) save directly when transaction fields are unchanged. Recorded rows and the amount/description template stay intact. The scope dialog now uses one scrolling column with three evenly spaced buttons.

1. Change only the end date: no popup, transaction and confirmation unchanged.
2. Repeat with remaining count and frequency.
3. Also change amount or transaction date: the scope dialog must appear.
4. Check complete text and all three buttons in portrait and landscape; scroll if needed.
5. Cancel the dialog: no transaction changed.

The opening balance may be zero or negative. It contributes to both total and cleared balances. Changing it recalculates both without changing transactions. Unsaved changes in this form are discarded when locking.
Enter a unique name and a valid amount with at most two decimal places. Maximum: 50 accounts.

Enter the closing statement balance and select the transactions present on the statement. The opening balance is included. Nothing changes until confirmation. Cancelling or locking discards this reconciliation session.
Enter a valid balance, including zero or a negative amount if needed.
Legacy date kept as-is. Choose a date to replace it.
Transfer to another account in this vault
One entry creates a debit here and the opposite credit in the other account. Clearing remains independent.
Amount, date and description update both sides. Accounts are fixed: delete the pair and create a new transfer to change them.
Transfer %1$s (%2$s) will be deleted in both accounts. Both balances will be recalculated. This action is permanent.
Internal transfer: excluded from income and expense category reports.
Selecting another account creates an opposite counterpart. The current direction and clearing are preserved; the counterpart starts uncleared.

Unlimited: leave both fields empty. Otherwise choose an inclusive end date in the calendar OR a total count including the first transaction (1 to 10,000). Choosing one limit clears the other. A precise start date is required.

Without this option, only this occurrence changes. With it: future amount, description, category and payment method. The schedule stays unchanged. To change frequency, stop the series and create a new one.
Stopping keeps existing transactions. Resuming catches up missed occurrences. Calculation runs after unlocking and during an open session, never while locked.
Only this occurrence (or pair) is deleted. The series continues; stop it in settings if needed. This occurrence will not be recreated.
Check amount, description, dates and limit. Creation: 1 to 10,000 total occurrences; existing series: 0 to 10,000 remaining.
Generation paused: storage or capacity limit reached. Remaining series and occurrences are kept. Back up before freeing space.
On confirmation, choose this transaction only or the future series. No other recorded occurrence changes.
On save, choose this transaction alone or the future series. No other recorded transaction will change.

This transaction: changes only its fields; series frequency and limits are ignored. With the series: updates the future template and schedule too. Other recorded transactions remain unchanged, even unconfirmed ones. An internal transfer updates both linked sides.

Number of new occurrences to generate, excluding recorded transactions. Zero ends the series; blank is unlimited. Choose a count OR an end date. The next date is after today and after already recorded/consumed occurrences.
